execution: Review JSON only. No migration/DDL command is generated or applied. Runtime SQL is exercised only by a statement-protocol double.

changes.before: NOT NULL reader and Telegram identity gate
changes.after: nullable; preserve existing uniqueness among nonnull Telegram IDs; no fake numeric ID or email match
nullable legacy column with enum clerk/telegram; new inserts require explicit provenance; immutable once written; old unmarked active rows deny503

after_constraints: one nonrevoked family per person (no now() index predicate); expired unrevoked family must be revoked before next insert
changes.compatibility: Current legacy Telegram relational writer does not stamp auth_provider. It must be updated and reviewed before any cutover; no automatic backfill.

columns.digest: text NOT NULL; exact64 lowercase hex; raw JWT never stored
columns.retain_until_ms: bigint NULL; null means do not GC until a reviewed bound exists

integrity.required_deferred_commit_check: Every new Clerk family has exactly one matching same-person binding and provider-session row. A Telegram family has no Clerk binding. A nullable FK alone is insufficient. Exact SQL/trigger implementation and real constraint validation remain NOT_RUN.
immutable: provider-session canonical person and first nonnull retirement
proof digest family binding/expiry; consume/supersede monotonic
integrity.delete: Runtime role has no identity/fence/binding/replay DELETE; no cascading erase of histories. Reviewed retention worker is a future separate scope.

rls.schema: ua_private; must remain unexposed to Data API

role.name: PENDING_REVIEWED_BACKEND_ROLE
requirements: transaction-local context set only by trusted server path after signature verification

clerk_identities.update_limits: Only monotonic retirement for sessions. Identity/binding/replay reassignment disallowed by immutable guard.

clerk_student_sessions.update_limits: Only monotonic retirement for sessions. Identity/binding/replay reassignment disallowed by immutable guard.

clerk_family_bindings.update_limits: Only monotonic retirement for sessions. Identity/binding/replay reassignment disallowed by immutable guard.

clerk_exchange_replays.update_limits: Only monotonic retirement for sessions. Identity/binding/replay reassignment disallowed by immutable guard.

grants.PENDING_REVIEWED_BACKEND_ROLE: Only reviewed SELECT/INSERT and limited UPDATE; no DELETE. Existing people/membership policies must be reviewed, not replaced blindly.

notes: RLS context is not auth.uid() from a user_ subject. Canonical UUID is resolved server-side.
set_config is transaction-local; verify reset after pool reuse.
Role/grants/constraints and actual effective RLS must be tested on isolated Postgres before production. No service-role key goes into UI.

bounds: Do not drop retired sid until no future proof can be minted and all family/replay/tombstone/retry windows are closed
Old JWT exp alone is not a sid retirement bound
Retries never extend first retention; logical expiry applies before physical purge
not_assumed: provider terminal status guarantees no future reactivation

required_real_tests: same-identity creation race on separate connections
all partial-write rollbacks and commit uncertainty
current/retired SID and jti replay after process restart
scope/RLS cross-person denial and pool context leakage
old unmarked legacy compatibility and cutover of all old writers
expiry after lock/network/flush and immediately before real COMMIT
